name: At Tawwaab
description: Allah repeatedly enables His servants to repent and accepts their repentance.
summary: At Tawwaab expresses Allah's repeated acceptance of repentance and His enabling His servants to return to Him. Quran 2:128 includes a prayer for that acceptance, and 110:3 connects the name with seeking forgiveness. The short label therefore includes accepting repentance, not only guiding towards it.
